unresolvedReferences.description: 澶州 is rendered Chanyuan in both fields; the packet gives no romanization for 澶州, so not repaired.
天子 here is generic (the reigning emperor is not named in the unit); dispositioned as title.
Units s0287-s0292 are Gao Hua's career, placed in packet order between s0023 and s0024.
承平砦 is rendered Chengpu Fort; the packet does not establish the romanization, so not repaired.
洺州 is rendered Mozhou, the same as 莫州; the packet does not establish 洺's romanization, so not repaired.
高陽關 is rendered Gaoyang Gate here and in s0119 but Gaoyang Pass elsewhere; left as a translation variant.
籍 and 仲淹 are taken as Pang Ji and Fan Zhongyan from the prior chunk; kept as local people with short names.
太平天子 is a generic Son of Heaven in Rong's prediction; dispositioned as title.
白豹 is rendered Baimu; the packet does not establish the romanization, so not repaired. The three tribes are taken as named after their chiefs.
Pang Ji here (circuit transport commissioner) is kept as a local person; identity with the Pang Ji of earlier chunks is not asserted.
宋庠 is rendered Song Qi in both fields; the packet does not establish the romanization of 庠, so not repaired and the packet form is kept.
麻氈 (Ma Zhan) and 黨留 (Dang Liu) are treated as tribal names, not persons.
Xun is posthumously honored and then said to have died later among the enemy; both statements are recorded as given.
澶州 is rendered Cao Prefecture; the packet does not establish the romanization of 澶, so not repaired.
劉璠堡 is treated as a fort name (Liu Fan's fort), not a person.
左騏驥副使 is rendered Left Qilin Guard, while s0064 renders 騏驥 as Qiji; left as a translation variant.
種世衡 is rendered Zhong Shiheng here but 种世衡 is Zhong Shihang in s0057; the packet is inconsistent, so not repaired.
今之飛將 (flying general of today) is a comparison, not treated as a name for Xiang Bao.
Xun's death here is in the historians' comment; chunk 003b records his capture and later death among the enemy.
